name: Cinematic Photorealism
visual_style: Photorealistic live-action cinema with natural skin textures, realistic environments, cinematic depth, subtle film grain and restrained color grading.
camera: Smooth deliberate dolly or tracking shot with natural depth of field.
lighting: Motivated natural lighting with plausible shadows and highlights.
motion: Physically believable movement, natural timing, realistic fabric and hair dynamics.
consistency: Maintain subject identity, geometry, wardrobe, environment and all distinctive details across frames. Avoid morphing, duplicate limbs, unwanted object changes and camera jumps.
negative_guidance: Avoid flicker, temporal inconsistency, deformations, unnatural body motion, random text, unintended logos and watermarks.
